title: Family on Rocky River Bank, 1950s B&W Mountain Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot from around the 1950s featuring a family—a man holding a small child, standing alongside a woman—perched atop a large rock formation along a mountain stream. The background shows dense pine and aspen trees stretching up a hillside, capturing mid-century American outdoor recreation and family road trips into national parks or mountain regions.
